description: This file defines a culture info object for Serbian (Latin script) specific to Bosnia and Herzegovina, providing localized date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns, and parsing functions used by the DateJS library.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to midnight.
